purpose: Preserve empirically learned design judgment so fresh Guides improve Prometeo without erasing known-good behavior or reintroducing historical coordination regressions.
authority_note: Human directives and newer exact evidence may challenge this DNA. Challenges must be explicit, isolated, benchmarked, lineage-preserving and promotable; silent overwrite is forbidden.
mandatory_for: fresh/replacement Guide before architecture or runtime strategy changes
any material change to worker orchestration, scheduler, claims, leases, recovery, reincarnation, evaluator, Guide coordination or Live/TV coupling
any proposal that adds a new coordination layer or changes the worker-facing ABI
operating_rule: READ DNA -> identify touched invariants/vaccines/goldens -> declare preservation contract -> isolate change -> compare against baseline -> promote only with evidence -> update DNA/lineage if the lesson changed.
truth_law: Historical chat recollection is useful candidate evidence, not VERIFIED evidence until linked to durable receipts/runtime artifacts.
